data_scope: NQ/ES 1-minute RTH clean 2011-08..2026-07 (already-consumed exploratory data) plus synthetic AR(1) and fBm. No holdout is involved.
primary_metric: per-slot selection-rate CV of the fixed-threshold expanding-window Hurst gate, versus a same-slot z-scored H at matched global selection rate, on NQ and ES.
result_summary: HYP-0001 NOT killed on all 3 cells. Cell A (positive): fixed-threshold expanding-window Hurst gate per-slot selection-rate CV is 2.88-45.59x (NQ, median 23.93x) / 5.90-46.48x (ES, median 21.75x) a matched same-slot z, at all 7 published thresholds; kill threshold was 2.0x. At H>=0.55 the gate fires on 33.5% of 10:00 vs 8.4% of 15:59 NQ decisions (31.7%->5.2% ES). Mechanism is DISPERSION not level (sd compresses 3.80x/3.54x, mean moves 0.02). Degenerate signflip null (true H=0.50) reproduces ~half the ramp. Cell B (predicted null): rule-23 reproduction exact 8/8 to 1e-4; bias correction moves pooled AC1 by <=0.00006 vs a 0.01 threshold -- BUT slot-demeaning cuts it ~half (wilder_10_50 0.4411->0.2198 NQ), ranking preserved. Cell C bounded analytically (max bias 0.00025 at T=44516), not re-run -- declared deviation.
